resources.string: A pocket archive of the music you know by heart.
Browse albums and songs, and explore their stories.\nRead lyrics and discover the details.\nFollow tour dates and look forward to the next show.
A few things to know before you begin.
Jay Archive is an unofficial fan archive for release information, lyrics and concert schedules. Some features use the internet. Please read the details before continuing.
I have read and understood the usage and privacy information
Three styles, one archive. You can change these later in Settings.
Rounded surfaces and the familiar HyperOS feel
Start with an album. Rediscover Jay Chou.
Your appearance choices will be saved when you enter.\nBrowse the album catalog offline. Lyrics lookup, artwork and concert information use the internet.

Local data\nBrowsing the archive requires no registration. Appearance preferences, profile details and images stay on your device. Music sign-in credentials are encrypted and excluded from system backups. You can clear app data in system settings.

Online content\nOnline music sends sign-in, search, playlist, lyrics and playback requests and the corresponding account credentials to the music services you configure. Concert details and images access sources such as JVR and Damai. Update checks connect to GitHub. These services receive request contents and your IP address. Automatic update checks can be disabled in Settings.

About this archive\nThis app is not affiliated with Jay Chou or the relevant rights holders. Online playback follows platform and account permissions. Music downloads and ticket transactions are not provided. Content belongs to its rights holders. Check official sources for current event information.
